launches.title: Chamber – Autopilot for AI Infrastructure 🚀
launches.tagline: Turning Idle GPUs Into Enterprise AI Velocity
launches.body:
# **TLDR;**

[**Chamber**](https://www.usechamber.io) is building AI infrastructure platform that automates governance and resource optimization for enterprise.

**Ask**: If you’re at (or know) a company spending **millions on reserved GPU infrastructure** we’d love to talk.

Our Launch Video: <https://youtu.be/w5Nk1wleigc>

**Who are we?** We're former Amazonians that helped build and scale large-scale infrastructure optimization, delivering hundreds of millions in cost savings, and we’re now bringing those learnings to help other enterprises uncover idle AI infra, accelerate workloads and reduce wasted money on reserved idle GPUs. _([Featured in Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/amazon-strategy-overcome-gpu-shortages-nvidia-2025-4))_

LinkedIn: [Charles](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dingcharles/), [Shaocheng](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shaocheng-wang-b766b7a6/), [Jason](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jshenong/), and [Andreas](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andreasbloomquist/)

**Problem:** Despite massive AI infrastructure investments, 30–60% of enterprise reserved GPU capacity sits idle in siloed allocations, slowing down teams who need it most, and silently driving up costs. This inefficiency represents $240B+ in annual waste across the industry, and it’s only growing as AI research and development accelerates.

**Solution:** [Chamber](https://www.usechamber.io) puts your AI infrastructure on autopilot. Our agentic AI enabled platform orchestrates, governs, and optimizes your AI infrastructure so teams can run \~50% more workloads on the same GPUs without manual intervention. It operates like an autonomous infrastructure team: continuously monitoring GPU clusters, forecasting demand, detecting unhealthy nodes, and reallocating resources in real time to where they create the most impact. Your ML teams move faster, infra waste drops, and GPU bottlenecks disappear.

* **Discover & optimize idle GPU capacity**\
  Automatically identifies underutilized GPUs and hidden optimization opportunities across clusters, teams, and workloads.
* **Agentic AI–driven orchestration**\
  Automatically right-size workloads, manage resource allocations, and orchestrate workloads across teams based on real-time demand and priority.
* **Self-healing infrastructure**\
  State-of-the-art bad-node detection with automated remediation to keep clusters healthy and jobs running.
* **Deep AI-powered analytics**\
  Detect anomalies, forecast usage, and slice and dice workloads by team, user, job type, or priority.
* **Proactive alerts & executive visibility**\
  Native integrations with Slack, Email, and PagerDuty, and more to deliver real-time alerts, executive digests, and clear action items.

Our Product Demo: <https://youtu.be/E8BLg7zi9mc>

**Who is this for:**

* **AI/ML teams** looking to move fast and run more workloads without manual GPU allocations, priority spreadsheets, or burning budget on unused GPUs 
* **Engineering leaders & executives** who need real-time visibility, accountability, and control over GPU spend to deliver higher ROI to their executives and shareholders

 

**A gift from us:** We’re offering a **complimentary GPU Intelligence Dashboard** and **advanced monitoring & discovery agent** that gives you immediate, production-grade visibility into your AI infrastructure.

* Automatically discover and expose unused GPU capacity in real time
* Understand utilization patterns across teams and workloads
* Receive executive-ready email reports on GPU usage and trends
* AI driven insights from your cluster utilization metrics

[Create an account](https://app.usechamber.io/signup) to start assessing your opportunity to run more workloads in minutes for free.

Want to talk with us? Schedule a call with us [here](https://usechamber.io/#contact).
